snippet.title: Dread Meridian | Reveal Trailer | Into the Infinite 2025
snippet.description:
Step into Dread Meridian, a new VR horror adventure set on a 1930s arctic expedition. Uncover ancient secrets and battle terrifying monsters in the search for your lost sister. Experience the terror solo or together with friends. 

Developed by Kukrgame
